text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, staying low until the Satsuki Sho...
If I cannot make a flashy entrance on the center stage—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It's an impromptu match, an impromptu match!
Trainer, follow my lead~!!

Looking for a breakthrough inside rather than out,
No Reason threw herself into mock race after mock race at Tracen Academy, but—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Uhohoi, hohoi! Hoi-hoi-pii!
Matikanefukukitaru claims a massive victory~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"This is all thanks to Shiratoki-sama and my divination!
Behold this splendid victory!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "Grmmmgh~, to think I would fall behind to such a shady fortune teller...!!"

Days of failing to win as desired continue.
The cause is...
choice_data_list: I can't help feeling she's vulnerable in the pack...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hoh, weak when jostled in the pack...
Meaning not suited for crowded racing, is that it?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's like my core's still a bit weak, or...
Yeah, it's like my core is still weak...

text_block_list.text: Running solo is fine, but in a tight pack, my stamina is instantly drained...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The core of my body, eh... I see.
I suppose the reason is that I still...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Is it because not much time has passed since my "coming of age"?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
To tell the truth, I...

text_block_list.name: No Reason's Mother
text_block_list.text:
She's born!
She's finally born, darling...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason's Father
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a relief...
Still, an Umamusume born in June, huh...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
“For an Umamusume entering a racing career,
she was born slightly late. Thus, there is a very slight
delay in her physical development.”

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The gap will likely close eventually,
but it may be tough for a while.
—A late foal. It wasn't a massive gap, of course, but it was unavoidable that she lacked resilience in a crowd.
choice_data_list: I see. Then it's only natural you couldn't win right now...
Right. Then it's only natural you can't win right now...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: KAAATSU!!!!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: How dull, throwing in the towel like that! It's precisely because the odds are against us that battle is so thrilling, is it not~?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I'll concoct an unthinkable strengthening plan! Or tease them, make them furious, and lure them into a trap♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
No Reason
text_block_list.text: I reckon it's a tactician's job to show the general the way when they're in a pinch, ya know~
It was my responsibility as a Trainer. For No Reason's sake, I decided to somehow find a breakthrough.
(Flip, flip-flip...)

Desperately poring over a "certain book" in the library.
Yes, that book is...

A book written about the "Silent Clan."
Inside that book, a systematic framework of running styles
was recorded.

An Umamusume whose running style is close to No Reason's.
If we could find someone like that,
they might make the ideal mentor.

Umamusume entered the track one after another.
Watching their running forms, I searched for one with a similar style.
(Rumble rumble rumble...)
(Rumble rumble rumble...)

Results were hard to come by. Just as hope began to fade—
a mighty gust of wind roared past.
Oraaaah!
No Reason found the exact role model she should aspire to be. That Umamusume was—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —What do you want?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Narita... Brian-dono?!
Trainer. So, this person is...

The Triple Crown Umamusume, Narita Brian.
A lone wolf boasting unmatched running power.
She might be blunt and hard to ask favors from, but she is definitely an Umamusume along No Reason's path of growth.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The master swordsman, Narita Brian...
Indeed, if one seeks a master, there is none better.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well now, Lord Brian!
Would you lend a hand
for the sake of my conquest of the realm?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —I refuse.

There was no getting through to her at all.
However...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: No way! Who would back down just from being rejected once!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Watch me, Trainer!
The path forward you found for me—
I will carve it wide open, without fail!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hear, hear, Lord Brian!
Wilt thou grant me a bout of sparring?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Brian-dono, what a coincidence.
Fate has brought us together at last!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, Brian-dono!
What a terrifying coincidence this is."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
As if a coincidence could happen in a place like this.
—You're persistent.

No Reason is persistent,
while Narita Brian remains blunt.
Their game of chase continues, but...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, for them to hate it this much...
I see, I see.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Lord Brian, could it be that thou
—art intimidated by mine presence?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"There's no chance of winning even if I run.
If that's what you thought, then it can't be helped, but..."

A glaringly obvious provocation.
It seemed unlikely they'd take the bait, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"—Very well.
Enter the gate."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Have you finally decided
to face me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's not it. It's just—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: If pests refuse to leave after being shooed away, you crush them. That's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaah!!
Doryaaaaah!!

Two fiercely competitive girls clash on the track.
However—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, as if the Junior Class could stand against me.
—Hah!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Gwoh?! This kick... in the final stretch...!?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
(As expected of a Triple Crown Umamusume...!
Feels like she's about to sweep me right off my feet.)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
(As expected, an ordinary effort won't even make it a contest.
However—)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Do not underestimate me, brat.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: To fall without leaving a trace of proof is a disgrace to a warrior! Even if... my very body is shattered to pieces!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I must land at least one strike!!
Deryaaaaaaaaaaah!!!!!

It was a way of running that shouldn't be done right now.
A reckless sprint pushed past the body's physical limits, with no regard for what comes after.

No Reason's body right now
could never endure it. Even so—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Take thiiiis,
Narita Brian!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ――Gh.

Maybe she couldn't even manage to rattle her.
The result was Narita Brian's complete victory. But—

For just a split second,
I thought I saw Narita Brian's eyebrow twitch.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *wheeze*... Even giving it
my absolute all... is this really the best I can do...?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
How frustrating...! How petty of me...!
To think there could be such a gap in our speed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Speed, huh...
True, there are countless fast Umamusume.
However—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
No matter how fast they are,
I fear them not in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: What... not in the slightest, you say?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah. In the end, they'll just be crushed by me. But...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"You are different.
That—fleeting, unyielding spirit."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Very well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: If you're going to persist this stubbornly and still brandish your blade against me...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sink your teeth in and keep up with my running.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Come challenge me anytime you like from now on.
I'll just crush you all over again.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Brian-dono! You'll spar with me?!
Much obliged! Much obliged!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, there's no need to thank me.
Or perhaps, by running with you...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It might just come back to me. That feeling from when hunger was all I ever knew.

A victory won through No Reason's persistence.
And so, Narita Brian agreed
to teach her how to run.
